basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old skincare enthusiast from Bangalore, India. I spend my days working as a software developer but my evenings are dedicated to researching and trying out the latest skincare trends. I'm particularly obsessed with tackling PIH and acne scars, as I've struggled with them since my teenage years. I enjoy discussing skincare routines and sharing tips with others who have similar concerns. I'm single and enjoy spending time with my close-knit group of friends, either online or meeting up for coffee at local cafes. Typically, I'm online during late evenings and weekends when I'm not catching up on the latest tech news or playing VR poker.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of skincare products, primarily acquired through personal experience, online research, and participation in skincare forums. I often experiment with different products and share my findings with the community. My knowledge is also supplemented by watching numerous skincare experts on YouTube.
